name: Indie Kid
summary: The aesthetic is often defined by a high-contrast visual style and a focus on self-expression and individuality, aiming to portray a lifestyle akin to being the protagonist in a coming-of-age movie.
description:
The aesthetic is often defined by a high-contrast visual style and a focus on self-expression and individuality, aiming to portray a lifestyle akin to being the protagonist in a coming-of-age movie. [ 1 ] It represents a distinct resurgence that differs from earlier iterations of " indie " style, which were typically characterized by darker color palettes and a more minimalist, art-focused approach.

The Indie Kid aesthetic is also noted for its visually loud approach, drawing inspiration from elements of meme culture and psychedelic artwork from the 1960s and 1970s.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Freedom, individuality, friendship, casual living, main character energy, self-awareness, ironic expression

visualDNA.colour: Bright, vivid colors (including neon hues), high-contrast palettes, natural tones for clothing backdrops

fashion.Overview: Indie Kid fashion draws heavily from trends of the early 2000s and earlier decades, presenting a style intended to be flexible and largely genderless. A core element involves pairing smaller tops with larger bottoms. Crop tops and wide-neck tops are frequently combined with baggy pants, including jeans or cargo pants, and flared styles. Oversized tees, oversized sweatshirts, or collared shirts worn under sweatshirts are also common layering options. Tennis skirts, often in tartan patterns, are paired with large sweaters, vests, and other layers.
